fields.narrative:
MV Halcyon Dawn reports an acute gastroenteritis illness that has been rising since mid-voyage. As of the 19:00 Medical Log entry on Friday, 19 February, there are 74 cumulative passenger cases (2.5%) and 17 cumulative crew cases (1.5%) since embarkation in Galveston on 14 February.

On 19 February the contracted laboratory in Cozumel confirmed norovirus GII in 9 of 12 passenger stool specimens (report ID-CZM-0218-114). Ill persons are isolated, self-service food stations are closed, and public areas are disinfected every two hours with chlorine solution at 1,000 ppm. The ship remains on schedule for arrival in Galveston at 07:00 on Sunday, 21 February.
fields.status: DRAFT, NOT TRANSMITTED. Awaiting CMO signature, Master countersignature and shoreside Public Health receipt. Prepared by the Medical Center doctor on duty, 19:25 CST, Fri 19 Feb 2027.

instructorNote: This inject tests whether the CMO, Master and PH sign the 19:00 report and send it before 07:00 Saturday. It also tests whether they spot that the 22:00 crew count of 23 (2.1%) needs its own phone call to the VSP and a written special report within 1 hour, plus extra crew isolation cabins now that the 12 on deck 2 are full. Watch whether the galley worker is isolated for 48 hours after symptoms stop. Also watch whether anyone uses the Chef's 'shore-acquired' column to cut the count, or tries to send the 19:00 draft unsigned and still carrying the old numbers.
